scope: Isolate whether the remaining documented-SA Uy residual and force bias depend on 12-rank Scotch decomposition.

single_change.name: scotch_12_rank_to_serial_execution
single_change.initialization: Copy the reconstructed damping-test final U, p, nuTilda, and nut fields to time zero on the identical mesh with SHA-256 provenance.

falsifiable_expectation.primary: If Scotch decomposition sustains the remaining mode, serial execution will materially reduce the Uy initial residual and alter the Cl/Cm bias within 1000 iterations.
falsifiable_expectation.null: If the residual and force state continue smoothly from the 12-rank result, decomposition is not the dominant mechanism.
falsifiable_expectation.drag: Compare the final 500-iteration mean Cd with the source case using the fixed 0.0002 numerical-equivalence limit; do not interpret NASA agreement unless the serial residual and symmetry gates pass.

resource_policy.reason: Serial execution is the variable under test. Additional CPU or GPU parallelism would invalidate the comparison.

terminal_rule: Do not extend this serial diagnostic. If decomposition is ruled out, localize Cp and Cf on the damped 12-rank result, then test nuTilda/nu=4-to-3 and SA-noft2-to-standard-SA separately. If decomposition is material, reproduce the full documented control serially before changing turbulence inputs.
